english_evidence: Aggregator autorijschooltarieven.nl lists 'Taal: Nederlands'; own website (rijschoolrosmalen.nl) and all customer reviews are entirely in Dutch with no English/EN option.
notes: One-man/family school run by instructor Erik Barella (with wife Yolanda; aggregators also mention 'Corina' as a fixed instructor). Offers car (B) and motorcycle (A1/A2/A) lessons plus theory and faalangst (test-anxiety) training. Founding 'sinds 1998' on own site corroborated by KvK registration date 01-01-1998 (Vof.). Email e.barella@ziggo.nl. Transmission (automaat vs schakel) NOT confirmed: the clickdrive.nl 'Over ons' description is template bleed describing an unrelated school (Verkeersschool Corina, Voorschoten) and was disregarded. CBR Den Bosch exam location; ~31-38 exams/yr; first-exam pass rate ~71-76%. Google 3.8/5 (18 reviews); some very negative reviews mention poor communication on setbacks.
